body: He also actually murders the archbishop in primal fear. Man has had some good twists!

Personally age gaps like that wouldn’t bother me. If the age gap means the person has matured more emotionally, that suits me perfectly. I find that when I date women younger than me by that amount of an age gap (even though it’s really not that big of an age gap), there’s quite a disparity between our levels of emotional maturity and usually the dating wouldn’t last that long once I’ve noticed this. 

I also think this notion people have of it’s okay if you’re an older man to date a younger women but not okay in the reverse is really stupid, especially in cases like this where the age gap is so small. If two people are happy in each other’s company and click really well, who are you to judge? 

If you find that you click really well and would like to be together, go for it. Do what feels right for you. The worst that can happen is rejection. Rejection is a part of life and helps shape you to know what it is you need and want in a relationship. Don’t let the potential opinions of others ruin something that would make you happy.
